name: Fabric.js
role: Canvas object model with selection, serialisation and SVG import/export
summary: Canvas 2D library that wraps drawn items as editable objects (shapes, text, images, groups, paths) with transforms, serialisation to JSON and a two-way SVG parser. Includes tweening of position, transform and style. Driven by script against a canvas; output is canvas pixels, JSON or SVG. Its strength is an editor-grade object layer with interaction built in.
use_when: Editable canvas objects that round-trip through SVG or JSON
Over Konva when SVG import/export and JSON serialisation matter most
Template-style compositions where objects are loaded, edited and exported programmatically
Image or text overlays with filters on a canvas
avoid_when: Deterministic frame-by-frame motion graphics: GSAP on SVG or p5.js
Pure vector geometry and boolean path ops: Paper.js
Lightweight interactive scene graph with React bindings: Konva
notes: 2026-10-26: fabricjs.com did not state a licence or Node support; MIT is from the npm registry and Node support was not verified.

assessment.rationale: GitHub release v7.4.0 on 2026-05-18, MIT per npm. Distinct from Konva through SVG parser and JSON serialisation; fabricjs.com confirms tweening and SVG in both directions.

evidence.result: 90 distinct 1280x720 alpha frames at 30 fps; all shuffled hashes equal sequential; frame 45 alpha min 0 max 1. Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, Node 22.19.0; screenshot route. Contact sheet inspected.
evidence.scope: StaticCanvas Rect, Circle, Path and Group set from t, explicit renderAll, alpha PNG; macOS arm64 Chromium. No animate(), Text, SVG/JSON, filters or interaction.
